detail.title: Integrated Solar Monitoring System(Without Lithium Battery)
detail.overview: Compare Favourite KIT/DH-PFM378-B125-CB/DH-SD49425DB-HNY-GQ-EAU Integrated Solar Monitoring System(Without Lithium Battery) Key Points • Angle Flexible Adjustment of Solar Panel and Camera Mount • 125 W Monocrystalline Solar Panel • Aluminum Alloy Frame • Built Sturdy to Resist Storms with Sustained Winds up to 117 km/h. (Note: The Following Four Functions Are Only Supported When Battery Power Is Used) • Remote Monitoring Available through the Mobile App • Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) Charging Controller • 1/2.8" 4Megapixel STARVIS CMOS Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Others: Over-temperature, over-discharge, over-voltage and low-temperature protection of battery; overload and short circuit protection of load.
General.Output Port: CSA authorized M15 2-core waterproof connector (connected to lithium battery)
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; recording; send email; preset; pattern; tour; alarm digital input
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection
General.Applicable Area: Areas with daily exposure to solar radiation for more than 3.5 hours
General.Protection: IP66, TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
General.Certifications: CE: EN55032/EN55024/EN50130-4 FCC: Part15 subpartB, ANSI C63.4-2014
General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.6; B/W:0.0005 lux@F1.6; 0 lux (illuminator on)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless; Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; crossing fence detection; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, capturing snapshots, and enhancing face images. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing and quality first.

General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view; multiple colors available
